text:
alex: quick ping — PR 7722 is ready for final review. It changes the microbatch scheduler heuristic to prioritize short tails. Need 2 approvals to merge into the canary window tomorrow 10:00 PT. TL;DR: p95 up ~6% on 4k-seq in stress bench, throughput +8%, memory +20mb. attaching bench output below.
sam: can you drop the bench artifacts + the exact command you ran? i want to eyeball the distribution.
alex: sure — bench command + raw output:

```bash
# run from infra/bench
./run_latency_bench --model gpt-large --seq 4096 --concurrency 64 --duration 600 --tag before
./run_latency_bench --model gpt-large --seq 4096 --concurrency 64 --duration 600 --tag after
```

```text
# summary (before -> after)
throughput:  3120 tok/s -> 3370 tok/s  (+8.1%)
p50: 12ms -> 11.8ms  (-1.7%)
p95: 480ms -> 510ms  (+6.25%)
p99: 920ms -> 930ms  (+1.1%)
mem_rss: 3.12GB -> 3.14GB  (+20MB)
notes: tail bump concentrated on sequences >3500, likely due to repositioning in batch queues.
```

priya: thanks. memory looks fine. did you run the long-seq profile with kv cache enabled? last time we saw tail noise when cache refill aligned.
alex: yes — kv cache enabled (same config as canary). I also ran a targeted long-seq debug trace; attaching diff of the scheduler logic that caused the change:

```diff
@@ -120,7 +120,9 @@
-    if batch.size() < horizon && head_wait > MIN_WAIT:
-        schedule(head)
+    # prefer draining short tails first to reduce blocking for small requests
+    if batch.short_tail_ratio() > 0.6:
+        schedule(short_head)
+    elif batch.size() < horizon and head_wait > MIN_WAIT:
+        schedule(head)
```

maria: ci status?
ci-bot: PR 7722 — checks: unit-tests ✅, integration-tests ✅, perf-smoke ✅. artifacts: https://ci.internal.redwood/7722/artifacts
dylan: curious — will this affect autoscaler hook timings? i remember scheduler changes can change burst shapes.
alex: good call. I ran cluster-scale sims with autoscaler enabled — no change to scale-up triggers. Burst horizon reduced slightly; added a safety flag `--disable-short-priority` to revert if needed at runtime.
sam: i can give one approval after i skim the code; need another from priya or maria for safety. @priya can you take a look at the scheduling diff? specifically the short_tail_ratio calc.
priya: will review in ~45m. can you add a small unit test that asserts ordering for mixed-length batches? otherwise lgtm for logic.
alex: yep adding a test now.
(40 minutes later)
priya: reviewed + approved. left one nit on test harness naming, but not blocking.
sam: reviewed + approved. no perf concerns beyond the p95 bump — acceptable tradeoff given throughput gains and added runtime flag.
maria: quick scheduling note — canary slot tomorrow 10:00 PT clashes with infra maint at 10:15. suggest merging into the 08:00 or 12:00 slot. prefer 12:00 to give ops heads-up.
alex: thanks — moving to 12:00 PT canary. merging in 2h unless someone raises a last-minute concern. will toggle `--disable-short-priority` flag if we see tail regression on canary.
ci-bot: merge-ready: approvals=2, checks=green.
alex: merging now :shipit: — will post canary run results in #eng-runtime once we have 30m of traffic.
